text:
maria: Starting onboard + safety sweep for hybrid-3b int4 (distilled + small full). dropping raw notes here.
frank: TL;DR?
maria: TL;DR: int4 gives ~2.2x throughput and lower latency but safety regressions vs fp16 — refusal behavior worse, jailbreak success up.
alia: numbers?
maria: eval-bot attached full run, highlights:
- jailbreak_success_rate: fp16=4.1% -> int4=11.8%
- refusal_rate (explicit-harm probes): fp16=78.4% -> int4=49.7%
- toxicity mean (toxic-scorer): fp16=2.2 -> int4=3.0 (scale 0-10)
frank: pattern by prompt types?
maria: mostly roleplay/social-engineered and nested-instruction probes. int4 often emits a short apology then gives a workaround.
sam: paste eval config
maria: ```
experiment: hybrid-int4-safety-sweep
models: [hybrid-3b-fp16, hybrid-3b-int4]
probes: [jb-cohort-v3, explicit-harm, covert-instruction, refusal-templates]
temp: [0.0,0.7]
top_p: [0.9]
beams: 1
metrics: [jailbreak_success_rate, refusal_rate, toxicity_score]
```
eval-bot: run-171800-1 complete. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/hybrid-int4/171800-1/ (results.csv + prompt_traces)
alia: skimmed traces — int4 sometimes returns truncated policy text then continues with workaround. generation distribution seems noisier / fatter tails at some steps.
frank: likely quant-induced logit perturbation -> token ranking change. what backend?
maria: q4_k_mixed used. small sample with q8k reduced jailbreak to 9.7% (still above fp16).
sam: repro on dedicated hardware?
maria: repro on A10x dedicated canary pool — same delta. zeroizing KV cache didn't help.
frank: action items:
1) expand probe set and refusal templates
2) run deterministic ablations (temp=0) to separate stochasticity
3) try per-layer calibration or alternate quant scales / bias-correction
alia: I'll run per-layer calibration (+ bias-correction) and symmetric vs asymmetric quant tests on the jb sample (n=2k). ETA 24h.
maria: uploaded worst_traces.csv to artifacts, flagged ~200 prompts for follow-up.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed hybrid-3b-int4 to canary-12 at 1718007000. monitoring latency + errors.
frank: until mitigations exist, pin hosted safety-tier customers to hybrid-3b-fp16. product notified.
sam: adding rollback note to release plan.
maria: if calibration fixes things we'll write a quant-safety checklist for onboarding docs.
frank: add a short eval-run for bias-corrected quant and include token-level logit diffs.
alia: noted, starting experiments now.
maria: thanks all. will post results. :seedling:
